<!-- pr-reviewer: 9a40e703c781896fa6be336ed71e3fc072f13f4c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- The diff is test-only: one line in `crates/app/tests/stock_in_vise_sim.rs:103` and one decisions file. No assert changed.
- `LocateBody::Part` is the default (`crates/app/src/fixture_locate.rs:72-75`). The test mates faces on the entity `part`, so `Part` is the correct value. `Stock` would refuse these mates by name.
- The decisions file has the choice, the reason and the dropped option. Body ends `Fixes #2297`; `Changelog: none`.

Results merged with main (locally; main was already contained)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stock_in_vise_sim --test fixture_locate_stock --test fixture_locate_stock_body -j 6`: stock_in_vise_sim 2 passed, fixture_locate_stock 3 passed, fixture_locate_stock_body 5 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge: none.

Not exercised: the full batch gate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
